spend.title: What these mean
spend.sub: All from your receipts. Tap any (i) to open this again.
spend.monthText: What your receipts from this month add up to, after returns.
spend.allText: Every receipt you have added, after returns. It is Groceries plus Other purchases, minus Returns.
spend.groceriesText: Food and household things: produce, dairy, pantry, cleaning, paper goods.
spend.otherText: Things on the same receipts that are not groceries: pharmacy, clothing, electronics, hobbies, gift cards.
spend.returnsText: Money back for things you returned. Already taken off the totals above.
spend.savedText: Coupons, deals and discounts printed on your receipts. Already taken off what you paid.
spend.othersText: Gifts and things you bought for other people. Still counted in your spending.

trend.title: Price trend
trend.sub: How Arya works out a price move.
trend.row1Text: Arya compares the first and the latest price you paid at the store you use most for this item.
trend.row2Text: Sale prices count as what you paid. A trend needs 3 or more buys over 4 weeks or more. Moves under 2% are not shown.
trend.row3Text: This is your price, not an official inflation number.

cheaper.title: Cheaper store
cheaper.sub: How Arya picks the cheaper store.
cheaper.row1Text: The last price you paid at each store for this same item.
cheaper.row2Text: Only a different chain counts, never another branch of the same store, with a price from the last year that saves at least 25 cents and 5%.
cheaper.row3Text: Prices change. This is what you paid, not today's shelf price. Check the shelf price.

similar.title: Similar items
similar.row1Text: Other items you bought with the same kind of name, such as other milks.
similar.row2Text: When both names give a size, Arya shows the price per ounce so they compare fairly.
similar.row3Text: Arya never looks up prices on store sites, flyers or the web.

basket.title: Your prices over time
basket.sub: How Arya works out your own inflation.
basket.row1Text: Items you bought both then (60 to 120 days ago) and now (the last 30 days). Each item counts once.
basket.row2Text: Each item is weighed by how often you bought it in the last 3 months.
basket.row3Text: Your own prices at your own stores, not an official inflation number.

split.title: Buy where it's cheaper
split.row1Text: Your last 6 months. An item counts when you bought it at 2 or more stores.
split.row2Text: The other store must be a different chain and save at least 25 cents and 5% on that item.
split.row3Text: Travel time and gas are not counted.

waste.title: Food that expired
waste.row1Text: Items you marked "It expired" this month.
waste.row2Text: Each item at the price you last paid. An item with no price counts as $0.

lists.title: A list for every store
lists.body: Milk from Trader Jill's, Eggs from Costcozy and Blueberries from Whole Meadows? Arya makes it easy to keep a separate, tidy list for each store. Type, say it or click a picture of your paper list. No signal in the store? Keep adding and ticking; Arya syncs when you're back.
lists.s1: Tap More, then Lists, then tap New list.
lists.s2: Choose the name of the store from the dropdown.
lists.s3: Type in items using the add box, use voice to add items or upload pictures of your paper list.

share.title: Shared lists to shop in sync
share.body: Create shared lists with your household members. Anyone can add, edit or check off an item and Arya keeps the lists synced on every phone. Finish your grocery runs quicker together or split up and each take a store.
share.s1: Open Settings, tap Start a group and give it a name.
share.s2: Tap Invite someone and send the code to one person. Each code works once.
share.s3: When they join, your lists are shared. Anyone can add, change or check off an item, and every phone stays in sync.

maps.title: Get through the store faster
maps.body: Arya knows the store's layout, mapped by you or by other Arya shoppers, and walks you to each item in order. No more doubling back for the eggs. Turn it into a game with Quest if you like.
maps.s1: Open a store's list and tap Start shopping.
maps.s2: Arya walks you to each item in aisle order.
maps.s3: Store not mapped yet? Tap Map my store and walk it once.

news.title: Know what's in stock before you go
news.body: Arya shoppers report what's out of stock or back on the shelf at your stores, so you skip the wasted trip. See an out of stock item in the store, report it and help the next shopper. Store news is only accurate if shoppers report what's happening in the store.
news.s1: Open Today to see what Arya shoppers report at your stores.
news.s2: See an empty shelf? Tap Out of stock to let other shoppers know.

receipts.title: See where your money goes
receipts.body: Snap a receipt or add a PDF. Arya shows your spending by month, by store and by item. Every receipt is kept, so you can pull one up for a return, or for a refund when a product is recalled.
receipts.s1: Lists › Receipts, or the camera on a list.
receipts.s2: Snap the receipt or pick a PDF. Arya adds it and checks the total.
receipts.s3: Open Spending to see it by month, store and item, or open a receipt for a return or a recall refund. Tap a line on a receipt to fix its name, quantity or price. In Receipts, search, pick a date range and sort to find one fast.

prices.title: Know where it's cheaper
prices.body: From your own receipts and from Arya shoppers who share prices, Arya tells you whether your organic olive oil is cheaper at Trader Jill's or at Safeday.
prices.s2: Open Settings › About Arya › Arya's powers › Compare your stores.
prices.s3: Arya shows which store is cheaper per item, and adds prices from Arya shoppers who share them.

usesoon.title: Reduce food waste
usesoon.body: Snap the date on a pack, or pick a use-by date for fresh food. Arya nudges you to use it in time, so less food ends up in the bin.
usesoon.s1: After a receipt, Today asks for you. Any time: Settings › About Arya › Arya's powers › Use soon › Add a date.
usesoon.s2: Tap Take a photo of the date on the pack.
usesoon.s3: Check the item and the date, then tap Looks right, track it.
usesoon.s4: Arya reminds you what to use before it expires. Switch on Remind me in Settings, Preferences.

ask.title: Just ask
ask.body: Everything above, in a conversation. Type or talk: "What did I spend at Costcozy?", "Where is olive oil cheaper?", "What should I cook before the spinach goes bad?" Arya answers from your own lists and receipts.
ask.s2: Type or say your question, or tap a suggestion.
ask.s3: Arya answers from your own lists and receipts.
ask.s4: Tap Photo to send a picture, such as the date on a pack.

shopping.title: Start shopping
shopping.body: Pick a list and shop it. Play a Quest, or just tick items off.
shopping.s1: On Today, tap your next trip. Or tap More, then Lists, and open a list.
shopping.s3: Or tap "Or just tick items as I shop" for no game.
shopping.s4: Choose what Start shopping opens in Settings, under "When I start shopping".

running.title: Never run out
running.body: Arya learns how often you buy things, from your receipts, and suggests mostly staples. Something bought every two months or less often needs a steady history first, and Arya stops suggesting things you no longer buy.
running.s1: Open the Today tab. Look at Running low.
running.s2: Tap an item to see why Arya suggests it.
running.s3: In Ask, say "we finished the yogurt" to mark it as out.
running.s4: Arya then adds yogurt to the right store list.

quest.title: Shop like a game
quest.body: Quest turns your list into a game. You get points, a level and badges. There are no timers and no lives.
quest.s1: Open the Quest tab. Tap Start a quest.
quest.s3: Tap Find it for me to use the camera on a shelf.
quest.s4: Open Quest progress to see badges and mapped stores.

friends.title: Share what you found
friends.body: Add friends. After a trip, share a photo of what you bought.
friends.s1: Open the Quest tab. Tap Your trips and receipts.
friends.s2: Tap Friends. Add a friend by username.
friends.s3: After a trip, share a photo of your haul.

today.title: Make Today yours
today.body: Show the cards you use. Hide the rest. Next trip, at the top, starts your shopping.
today.s1: Tap Edit on Today, or touch and hold a card.
today.s2: Drag a card to move it. Tap the red minus to hide it.
today.s3: Tap the green plus to add a card from the library.
today.s4: Lists, Ask and Quest have an Edit button too.

bar.title: Make the bar yours
bar.body: Put the places you use on the bar at the bottom. Everything else stays in More, which is always there.
bar.s1: Tap More, then Customize bar. (Touching and holding the bar works too.)
bar.s2: Tap the green plus to put a place on the bar, such as Receipts or Stores. The bar holds four.
bar.s3: Tap the red minus to move a place to More. Drag to reorder.

powers.title: See everything Arya does
powers.body: Powers lists what Arya does for you now. It also shows what you can turn on.
powers.s1: Open Settings (in More), then About Arya, then Arya's powers. Or open Help.
powers.s2: Tap i on a power to learn how it works.
powers.s3: Under "You choose to turn on", tap Turn on for Community prices.

settings.title: Settings, your way
settings.body: Change how Arya looks and speaks. Your data stays yours.
settings.s1: Tap More, then Settings. Tap Display for text size and spacing.
settings.s2: Under Preferences, choose your currency and language, and switch on Remind me.
settings.s3: Under Account, tap Export my data to get a copy of everything. Delete my account erases it all; we email you a code to confirm, or ask for your password if you have one.
settings.s4: Open About Arya, then "Use Arya in another AI app", to add to your list from it.

endDemo.title: That's Arya
endDemo.openToFew: Arya is open to just a few people for now.
endDemo.line2: The best way in is to tell me what you thought.
endDemo.feedbackHint: What worked, what didn't, what you'd want next
endDemo.fine: Joins the beta list. Used only to invite you.
endDemo.thanksTitle: Thank you. You're on the list.
endDemo.thanksLine: Arya is open to a few people at a time. I read every note and I'll write to you when a spot opens.

developers.title: Arya for developers
developers.sub: Read and write your own lists and receipts from a script or another app. Export anytime.
developers.step1Body: In Arya, open Settings, then About Arya, then Use Arya in another AI app, then Make my code. It shows once. A new code replaces the old one.
developers.sameCode: The same code works for the Lists API and the agent connector.
developers.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it.
developers.limitsBody: shared with the agent connector. 256 KB a request, 50 items an add, 500 rows an import.
developers.stableBody: Version 1 will not change. New things are only added. Only your own data is in the API: no Arya suggestions or store maps.
developers.rLists: Your lists, with how many items are open
developers.rAdd: Add items by name or from text
developers.rPatch: Check off, change amount, move to another list
developers.rImport: Fill a list from text or CSV
developers.rReceiptsExport: Every receipt you filed, CSV or JSON
developers.rSpending: Totals by month and by store
developers.laterBody: Webhooks, sign-in with OAuth, sharing a list with another account, filing a receipt, and Quest data.
developers.authBody2: on every call. It reaches only your own account. Lost it or leaked it? Make a new code in Settings › About Arya and the old one stops working at once.
developers.endpointsLead2: to try them from the browser.
developers.eNotFound: No such list, item or receipt
developers.eRate: Over the hourly limit. Wait Retry-After seconds
developers.log2: Receipts, spending totals, and one 600-an-hour allowance for every route.

opsSettings.sub_data: Erase receipts or learned names, Supabase mirror
opsSettings.sub_accounts: Switch off, unfreeze, invites, owner account
opsSettings.sub_models: Photo reader, Spark plan, reasoning, open model
opsSettings.sub_limits: Hourly freeze, monthly, daily budgets, per-account overrides
opsSettings.sub_caps: Store scans, Kroger, MCP, feedback and waitlist emails
opsSettings.ownerNote: Pick an account that exists and confirm with your password. You keep owner rights for 24 hours, so a wrong pick can be undone from your old account. Locked out: see docs/OPS.md, Recover the owner.
opsSettings.ownerChanged: Owner changed. You can undo it for 24 hours.
opsSettings.deleteNote: This cannot be undone from the app. Arya saves a copy in the ops-deleted folder on the server first. Learned names of an account in a group belong to the group and are refused.
opsSettings.typeName: Type the account name to confirm
opsSettings.deleted: Erased. A copy was saved first.
opsSettings.mirrorNone: No database is set on the server
opsSettings.backfillSub: Copies every file into the database in the background
opsSettings.verifySub: Checks every file against the database
opsSettings.readerSub: Who reads receipt photos. Wonder is about $0.04 a photo, Spark about $0.01.
opsSettings.readerWarn: Spark reads send receipt photos to Spark. On the Contributor plan Meta may train on them.
opsSettings.tierSub: Which plan Spark calls run on.
opsSettings.tierWarn: Contributor lets Meta train on content sent to Spark, including receipt photos when the reader is Spark or Auto. Cheaper, but that data leaves your control.
opsSettings.effortSub: Higher is slower and costs more per call. Wonder and the store scan keep their own setting.
opsSettings.footer: Changes apply within seconds, need no restart, and are logged. Empty or "Use default" hands a setting back to the server's environment.
opsSettings.limitsIntro: These stop one account or the whole app from overspending.
opsSettings.limitsFooter: Each limit has a safe range so a typo cannot switch protection off. To stop all spending, use Pause all paid reads. An override applies to one account only.
opsSettings.capsFooter: Each cap has a safe range. They apply within seconds.
opsSettings.metaSub: Arya's ledger says ${{ledger}}. Type what Meta's dashboard shows to see the gap.

receipt.title: Add your first receipt
receipt.sub: Arya learns what you buy and how often
receipt.body: A receipt is how Arya learns. After one, Today shows what is running low and what to use soon.
receipt.s2: Tap Add receipts and pick one or several. Once sent, Arya reads them in the background, so you can leave.
receipt.s3: Arya adds it and checks the total.
receipt.n1: Only you and your group see your receipts.
receipt.n2: A return is taken off your spending.
receipt.n3: Arya turns short printed names into clear names, like Blackberries - Organic, and remembers them by item number. Names it is not sure of wait in To check with Arya's guess, the printed text and a section: tap Use this name, Fix or Keep printed, or Use the sure guesses to set every guess Arya is sure of at once (Undo puts them back).
receipt.n4: Spot a mistake on a filed receipt? Open it and tap the line to fix its name, quantity or price. Fixed lines show an "edited" tag. The printed total stays as printed, and the receipt says so if the lines stop adding up. Undo puts the old values back.

additem.title: Add an item to a list
additem.sub: Type it, say it, or snap a paper list
additem.body: Every list is one store. Add items in the box at the top of a list.
additem.s1: Tap More, then Lists. Next trip on Today has Add items too.
additem.s2: Open a list, or tap New list and choose a store.
additem.s3: Type an item in the box "Add item here...".
additem.s4: Tap the microphone to say it, or the camera to read a paper list.
additem.n1: Tap the circle to tick an item off as you shop.
additem.n2: Tap an item to change its name, amount or unit, add a note, move it or delete it.

ask.title: Ask Arya a question
ask.sub: What is running low? Where is milk cheaper?
ask.body: Ask in your own words. Arya answers from your lists and receipts.
ask.s2: Type your question, or tap Talk to say it.
ask.n1: Arya can also add or remove items, mark an item as out, count your receipts and trips, and suggest a dish from food to use first. Tap New chat to start again.
ask.n2: Tap Photo to send a picture, such as the date on a pack.
ask.n3: After you tap Talk, a Listening card shows a moving bar and a timer. Tap Stop and send when you are done, or Cancel.

lists.title: Lists
lists.body: Arya keeps a separate list for each store and suggests what is due.
lists.s1: Tap More, then Lists, and tap New list.
lists.s3: Add items in the box at the top of the list.
lists.s4: Tap an item under "Suggested for ..." to see why Arya suggests it.
lists.n1: Tap Select to move or remove several items.
lists.n2: The three dots on a list open Share, export or import.
lists.n3: No signal? Keep adding, ticking, editing and removing items. Changes save on this phone and sync when you're back online.

receipts.title: Receipts and spending
receipts.sub: Add a receipt, see where money goes
receipts.body: Arya reads a receipt, checks the total and keeps it for returns and recalls.
receipts.s1: Open Spending, then Receipts, and tap Add receipts.
receipts.s2: Take a photo, pick a PDF, or paste order text.
receipts.s3: Spending, on the bar, shows it by month, store and item.
receipts.n1: Ask "What did I spend in October?" for one month.
receipts.n2: In Receipts, search by store or amount, pick a date range, and sort by date, total or Store A to Z.
receipts.n3: In a group, anyone can fix a line on a shared receipt, but only the person who filed it can delete it.
receipts.n4: On Spending, tap (i) next to a heading to see what it counts. Groceries is food and household. Other purchases is everything else on the same receipts. All-time spending is both, minus returns.

prices.title: Prices
prices.sub: Which store is cheaper, what went up
prices.body: Prices come from your own receipts, and from Arya shoppers who choose to share.
prices.s2: Look at the cards "Cheaper elsewhere" and "Price watch" on Today.
prices.s3: Open Settings, then About Arya, then Arya's powers, for Compare your stores and Price trends.
prices.n1: Community prices are off until you turn them on: Settings, About Arya, Arya's powers, Community prices.
prices.n2: Arya never uses store sites, flyers or web prices.

shopping.title: Shopping and Quest
shopping.body: Start shopping when you are at the store. Choose to play a Quest or just tick items.
shopping.s1: Tap Start shopping on Today, or open a list and tap it there.
shopping.s2: Or tap "Or just tick items as I shop" for no game.
shopping.s3: In a Quest, Arya walks you to each item. Tap Find it for me to use the camera.
shopping.n1: Settings, then Preferences, then "When I start shopping", sets what opens.
shopping.n2: Quest has no timers and no lives.

map.title: Map my store
map.sub: Walk the aisles, Arya builds the map
map.body: Walk the aisles once. Arya builds the store map, then walks you to each item in order.
map.s2: Tap Map my store and choose the store.
map.s3: Walk the aisles with the camera. Tap Done when you finish.
map.s4: Arya builds the map in the background. A card tells you when it is ready.
map.n1: No signal? Frames save on your phone and send later.
map.n2: Arya blurs people in the frames before anything is kept.

news.title: Store news
news.body: Arya shoppers report what is out of stock or back on the shelf, so you skip a wasted trip.
news.s2: Look at "Near you today" for news from your stores.
news.s3: Seen an empty shelf? Tap Out of stock under "Report something yourself".
news.n1: A heads-up also shows at the top of a list.
news.n2: Store news needs reports from other Arya shoppers. It fills up as more shoppers near you use Arya.

share.title: Share with your household
share.body: A group shares lists and receipts. Everyone sees every member's receipts, past ones and receipt photos too. Every phone stays in sync. Groups need an account, so the demo has no Start a group row.
share.s1: Open Settings and tap Start a group. Give it a name.
share.s2: Tap Invite someone and send the code to one person. Each code works once.
share.s3: When they join, you share the same lists.
share.n1: Friends: Quest tab, then Your trips and receipts, then Friends.
share.n2: To send one list, tap the three dots on it, then Share, export or import.

ai.title: When to double-check Arya
ai.sub: Where Arya uses AI and can be wrong
ai.body: Arya uses AI to read photos, receipts and voice and to answer questions. It can be wrong.
ai.s3: Read where AI is used and what to check.
ai.n1: Always check an expiry date on the pack yourself. If food looks or smells off, do not eat it.
ai.n2: You confirm photo and receipt reads before they are saved.
ai.n3: Most of what you send to Arya is read by Muse Spark. Receipt photos are read by Muse Spark first too; Muse Wonder re-reads only a receipt the checks flag.

usesoon.title: Use soon
usesoon.body: Add a date to food. Arya reminds you to use it before it goes bad.
usesoon.s1: After a receipt, Today asks you for dates.
usesoon.s2: Any time: Settings, About Arya, Arya's powers, Use soon, Add a date.
usesoon.s3: Tap Take a photo of the date on the pack.
usesoon.s4: Check the item and the date, then tap Looks right, track it.
usesoon.n1: Today shows a "Use soon" card and a "Still good?" check. Still good? asks about fresh food only in the days after it usually turns, from the receipt date, and never about food bought over a month ago.
usesoon.n2: Ask Arya knows these dates too: ask "What goes bad this week?"

customize.title: Change Today
customize.body: Make Today show what you care about.
customize.s1: Tap Edit on Today, or touch and hold a card.
customize.s2: Drag a card to move it. Tap the red minus to hide it.
customize.s3: Tap the green plus to add a card from the library.
customize.n1: Next trip is the first card. It has Start shopping, Add items and Scan a receipt. Lists, Ask and Quest have an Edit button too.
customize.n2: Settings, then Preferences, then Display, changes text size and spacing.

bar.title: Change the bar
bar.sub: Pick the four places at the bottom
bar.body: The bar at the bottom holds four places, then More. Put the ones you use there, such as Lists, Receipts and Stores.
bar.s1: Tap More, then Customize bar. (Touching and holding the bar works too.)
bar.s2: Tap the green plus to put a place on the bar. The bar holds four.
bar.s3: Tap the red minus to move a place to More. Drag a place to reorder.
bar.n1: More is always on the bar. Help, Settings and every place not on your bar are in it.
bar.n2: The bar starts as Today, Spending, Quest, Ask and More. Reset to default brings it back.

install.title: Put Arya on your Home Screen
install.body: Arya has no App Store or Google Play app. Add it to your Home Screen instead: it opens full screen, like an app, and can send reminders.
install.s1: iPhone: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. Leave Open as Web App on, then tap Add.
install.s2: Android: tap Install if Arya offers it. Or tap the menu ⋮ at the top right, then Add to Home screen or Install app.
install.s3: Open Arya from your Home Screen and sign in there.
install.n1: On the sign-in page, Add Arya to your Home Screen shows the steps. In the app it is in Settings, About Arya.
install.n2: Once Arya runs from your Home Screen, these steps no longer show.

reminders.title: Get reminders
reminders.sub: A nudge when something is about to run out
reminders.body: Arya can send one reminder a day, at most, when a staple is about to run out or food needs using. You turn it on once, in Settings.
reminders.s2: Under Preferences, switch on Remind me and allow notifications.
reminders.s3: Pick how many days ahead you want to hear. Tap Send me a test reminder to check.
reminders.n1: On iPhone, add Arya to your Home Screen first (iOS 16.4 or newer), then open it from there.
reminders.n2: If you do not see Remind me, reminders are not switched on yet.

ownkey.title: Use your own Meta key
ownkey.sub: Keep going past Arya's daily limit
ownkey.body: Arya runs on Meta's models and has a daily limit. Add your own Meta Model API key and your reads run on your Meta account instead, billed by Meta.
ownkey.s1: At dev.meta.ai, open API keys and create a key just for Arya. Set a usage limit on your Meta billing page.
ownkey.s2: In Settings, under Account, tap Your own Meta key.
ownkey.s3: Paste the key (it starts with LLM_) and tap Check and save.
ownkey.n1: Only a Meta key works. Arya keeps it encrypted on our server and only ever shows its last 4 characters.
ownkey.n2: If Meta rejects the key or it runs out of credit, Arya stops using it and says Needs attention. Replace or remove it there.
ownkey.n3: You are responsible for the key under Meta's terms. Removing it in Arya does not delete it at Meta.

ownKey.does2: In a group, it also covers Arya's checks on items your uploads add to the shared list.
